item.title: Rustic, but nice! Over two acres in New Jersey. $149,900
item.description: This house is rustic, but it has some nice details! It could definitely use some lightening up inside. The house was built in 1935. It is located on 2.28 acres in Branchville, New Jersey. The house features vaulted ceiling, wood floors, log walls, built-ins and exposed beams. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 848 square feet. $149,900 Contact Danielle Conklin with Kistle Realty: 973-250-3299 From the Zillow listing: Charming Rustic Log Cabin with 2 bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms. item.title: Circa 1820. On 20 acres in New York. Pretty setting! $639,000
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! Nice acreage too! I love the long driveway. This is known as Stonewall Farm. The house was built in 1820. It is located on 20.7 acres in Highland, New York. The house features wood floors, a lot of natural light, baseboards, a built-in corner cabinet, updated kitchen and a great screened in porch. There is a large detached garage on the property and a long driveway. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,244 square feet. $639,000 Contact Hayes Clement with Compass Gr

item.title: Nice woodwork! Attached greenhouse! One acre in Ohio. $250,000
item.description: This house has some nice woodwork! The attached greenhouse could be nice! The house was built in 1875. it is located on one acre in Danville, Ohio. The house features a covered front porch, unique door casements, original mantels, wood floors, pocket doors and a large attached greenhouse. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,342 square feet. $250,000 Contact Sam Miller with Re/Max Stars From the Zillow listing: Gorgeous historical country home that is filled with charm and character throughout and

item.title: Cute cottage with mountain views and a creek! C. 1941 in NC. $239,000
item.description: This is a cute, move in ready cottage with mountain views and a small creek! The house was built in 1941. It is located on .65 acre in Warrensville, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, crown moulding, a lot of natural light, baseboards and a nice kitchen sink. There is a detached storage shed on the property. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,030 square feet. $239,000 Contact Sandara Dollar with Realty One Group Results: 336-977-4599 From the Zillow listing: T

item.title: Privacy and potential! Over six acres near the Blue Ridge Parkway in Virginia. $159,900
item.description: This house has privacy and potential! This is a pretty area near the Blue Ridge Parkway! Nice acreage considering the price! The house was built in 1930. It is located on 6.51 acres in Hillsville, Virginia. The house could use a good cleaning out so you can really see what is there as far as details. The kitchen looks like it could be nice and there is a steam shower. The property has multiple outbuildings. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,185 square feet. $159,900 Contact Deborah Crigger with F

item.title: Unique exterior! Love the log cabin! Circa 1910 in Pennsylvania. $349,000
item.description: This house sure has a unique exterior! I do love stone houses. The log cabin at the pond is neat. The house was built in 1910. It is located on 1.67 acres in Hooversville, Pennsylvania. .The house features a covered front porch, stone fireplace, wood floors, baseboards and an updated kitchen. There is a large garage that has space above that could be an apartment. There is a log cabin that overlooks a private pond. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,165 square feet. $349,000 Contact J. Paul O’

item.title: That tree is special! Circa 1900. Over six acres in South Carolina. $395,000
item.description: That tree sure is special! This is a nice house and property. The interior could use some color, but I would want to choose my own colors anyway. The house was built in 1900. It is located on 6/6 acres om Walterboro, South Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, claw foot tub, a lot of natural light, crown moulding, crystal chandelier, baseboards and bead board. The property has mature trees and a couple of outbuildings. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,331 square fee

item.title: Love the beamed ceiling! Over an acre in South Carolina. $217,900
item.description: I love that beamed ceiling! It is pretty! This house has a nice yard too. The house was built in 1951. It is located on 1.45 acres in Florence, South Carolina. I love that is has a long circular driveway. The house features a large back patio, galley style kitchen, exposed beams, built-in bookshelves, large windows, some wood floors, crown moulding and updated bathrooms. There are two varieties of grape vines on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,949 square feet. $217,900 Contact

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Pretty views! Over two acres in Tennessee. $160,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! There are pretty views of the mountains from the porch. The house was built in 1915. It is located on 2.31 acres in Whitwell, Tennessee. The house features a covered front porch, enclosed upper porch, wood floors, baseboards, bead board and built-in shelves. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,160 square feet. $160,000 Contact Tiffany Jenkins with Century 21 Cumberland Realty: 423-718-0966 From the Zillow listing: Great location! So much Poten

item.title: $35,000! Pretty front door! Vintage bathrooms! Original wood floors! On 1/2 acre in Texas.
item.description: Hard to believe that price of $35,000. Going to assume it is a location issue. The front door is pretty! Love the vintage bathrooms. The house was built in 1940. It is located on .52 acre acre in Memphis, Texas. The house features multiple covered porches, arched front door with leaded glass, original wood floors, vintage bathrooms, baseboards and unpainted woodwork. A good cleaning and some landscaping would go a long way with this house! The house is bigger than it looks! Five bedrooms and thr

item.title: Love the details inside! Once owned by a state senator. C. 1855 in Vermont. $310,000
item.description: This house has some really great details! I love that it hasn’t been overly renovated. This house was once owned by Vermont State Senator, A. A. Butterfield. The house was built in 1855. It is located on .5 acre in Jacksonville Village in Whitingham, Vermont. The house features wood floors, baseboards, nice fireplaces, chair rails, nice cabinet space in kitchen, wide plank wood floors and vintage bathroom fixtures. There is an attached garage and a detached building. Three bedrooms, two bathroom

item.title: Porch goals! Huge attic! Almost two acres in North Carolina. $200,000
item.description: Porch goals! That is a huge attic! Can anyone understand what that mantel is made of? This house looks like a good cleaning would really make it shine. The house was built in 1930. It is located on 1.9 acres in Winston Salem, North Carolina. The house features a large wrap around front porch, original wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, vintage bathroom and a nice staircase. The kitchen could use some work, but it’s a nice sized space. This is the first time the house has been on the market

item.title: Pretty setting! Multiple outbuildings! Seven acres in Virginia. $365,000
item.description: I love that this property has multiple outbuildings and some acreage! Some of the equipment will be staying! The house was built in 1912. It is located on 7.1 acres in Onemo, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, exposed brick in kitchen, baseboards, enclosed back porch and picture rails. There is a run in for horses and a large garage/workshop. The waste oil heater, air compressor and car lift will be staying. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,006 square feet. $365,00

item.title: Eclectic interior! Pretty scenery! Almost two acres in Virginia. $250,000
item.description: This house has some eclectic interior features! The scenery sure is pretty! I’m curious about how active that railroad track is. The house was built in 1930. It is located on 1.76 acres in Blacksburg, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, small fenced in area for pets, wood floors, baseboards, knotty pine, pressed tin ceiling, vaulted ceiling, wainscoting and a claw foot tub. There is a large back deck with a hot tub. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,721 square feet. $250,000 Cont

item.title: Pretty scenery! Circa 1940. Over one acre in West Virginia. $124,900
item.description: Pretty view of the mountains and nice scenery! The house was built in 1940. It is located on 1.28 acres in Naoma, West Virginia. The house could definitely use some undoing of past renovations, but it has potential! The house features a covered front porch, enclosed back porch and a brick fireplace. There are two outbuildings on the property. There is a lot of outdoor activities near the home. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,422 square feet. $124,900 Contact Laura Collins with Old Colony Real
